description: Animates an input image into a short video with audio. Send a photo with a caption.

provenance.note: Captured verbatim from a successful Rey_Explosion_H3 run; only the output filename prefix is managed by this application.

length.note: Frames at 24 fps. 56 is about 2.3s and is the value verified on this machine; 124 is about 5s.

steps.note: The turbo LoRA is tuned for 8 steps.

filename_prefix.note: Set by the orchestrator per job. Never taken from user input.

width.note: Drives both the generation width and the size the input image is scaled to.

height.note: Drives both the generation height and the input image scale height.

image.note: The uploaded file's name inside ComfyUI's input directory. Set by the orchestrator after a validated upload.

unsupported.negative_prompt: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo exposes no negative conditioning input.
unsupported.cfg: This graph uses BasicGuider (no CFG scale input).
unsupported.model_choice: Only one diffusion model is installed.
